audit.why: Melee scaler with a resetting dash. She contests from level 3 and takes over on items; Aatrox's edge is the window where Bladesurge has no reset target.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: Vanguard's Edge (R) is 125/105/85 and leaves a blade wall that cuts your retreat. World Ender is 120/100/80 — fight with your escape path open behind you.
audit.corrected: Vanguard's Edge (R) drops a blade wall on 125s that cuts your retreat, so fight with your back open. World Ender beats her Bladesurge resets once Flawless Duet is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Flawless Duet (E, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10) stuns and grounds between the two blades, which shuts off Umbral Dash — that cooldown is the whole matchup. Bladesurge (Q) heals and resets off marked or dying targets, so Grievous Wounds matters.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto her. Infernal Chains (W) drags her back to the centre if she doesn't leave the zone — hold it for after Bladesurge (Q). Flawless Duet (E, 16s at rank 1) stuns and grounds between its two blades: while you stand there Umbral Dash is dead, so step out of the line. Bladesurge heals and resets, so buy Grievous Wounds before the long fight.

edits.after: Vanguard's Edge (R) drops a blade wall on 125s that cuts your retreat, so fight with your back open. World Ender beats her Bladesurge resets once Flawless Duet is spent.

edits.before: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Irelia. W (Infernal Chains) roots him if he doesn't leave the zone: use it to lock him for Q2/Q3 or to cut off his escape. He's mobile, so hold W until after he commits his dash, then chain him so he can't reset or kite your Q. Pop R (World Ender) for the heal, AD and move speed when you fully commit or to survive Vanguard’s Edge — never burn it for a single Q.
